name: Ragnaros
source: [logs: Season of Discovery] Melee 1,918 to 2,879 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 2.70 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 46 kills on Season of Discovery (Normal, 2026-09-09 to 2026-11-02): the median of 251 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (2,377), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (235 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,573 weapon damage, spread 0.611, a 2.25 s swing. Length: the main tank's time on him a kill, median 64 s (10th to 90th percentile 30 to 98). Weapon damage abilities: Elemental Fire 20564 5.5 a minute of tanking. Abilities: Elemental Fire 20564: 2,160 to 2,640 Fire and 600 Fire a second for 8 s (the Classic Era client's spell data; Wowhead confirms the duration), a proc on his landed hits at the logs' rate.
abilitiesSource: Elemental Fire 20564: 2,160 to 2,640 Fire and 600 Fire a second for 8 s (the Classic Era client's spell data; Wowhead confirms the duration), a proc on his landed hits at the logs' rate.
notes: Elemental Fire is a proc on his landed hits, blocked ones too (proc aura 20563, client data), at the logs' rate: on the Anniversary realms about 3 in 4 of his swings, in Season of Discovery's Normal far fewer. Its DoT is 8 ticks of 600, restarted by the next hit. Fire resistance from gear and buffs takes its share. Wrath of Ragnaros (every 25 to 30 s, 1,000 Fire and a knockback that wipes threat, so a second tank picks him up) and the submerge phase are left out: one tank's stint between knockbacks is what's scored.

healing.notes: From Season of Discovery's logs (46 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 3 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 1,150 a second with overheal and absorbs (29% of the heals effective), 1.42 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 439 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (9% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Druid 17, Warlock 12, Paladin 9, Rogue 3, Warrior 3, Shaman 2.

raidHealing.notes: What Season of Discovery raids had on Ragnaros (32 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 24 with 2 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 0 a second together, not in the events), 5 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (83% of the healing), each 1,431 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 2,860 a second (658 on the tanks, 2,132 on the rest, 68% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 100.2 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: Season of Discovery] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 32 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/sod_mc_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 89% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.12 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Lava Burst 21158 from Lionfish (49% of the non-tanks' damage, in 32 of 32 kills): 1,389 to 1,614 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 33% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 6 to 57), 49.4 landed a second on each (95% of it landing), so a cast every 7.26 s at random (the logs count 6.9 casts a minute), the first at 15 s (median) of a 94 s kill. Melee -4 from Son of Flame (14% of the non-tanks' damage, in 32 of 32 kills): 1,271 to 2,077 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 6% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 4 to 15), 13.9 landed a second on each (91% of it landing), so a cast every 3.47 s at random (the logs count 5.3 casts a minute), the first at 34 s (median) of a 94 s kill. Lava 6 from Environment (7% of the non-tanks' damage, in 32 of 32 kills): 285 to 688 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 5% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 12), 6.7 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 2.9 s at random (the logs count 9.5 casts a minute), the first at 14 s (median) of a 94 s kill. Lava Shield 21858 from Son of Flame (2% of the non-tanks' damage, in 32 of 32 kills): 59 to 60 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 12% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 4 to 38), 2.1 landed a second on each (92% of it landing), so a cast every 1.65 s at random (the logs count 6.8 casts a minute), the first at 35 s (median) of a 94 s kill. Together they land 100.2 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 100.2 in the logs.
